/Script/IRRMissionSystem.IRRMissionEvent.name: IRRMissionEvent_PlayMissionBriefing
/Script/IRRMissionSystem.IRRMissionEvent.tooltip:
Plays one variant of Briefing to the local player after StartDelay, through the same ability and variant
memory as UIRRMissionBriefingTriggerComponent (UIRRMissionBriefingLibrary). Runs on every machine with a
local player; a dedicated server does nothing. A start the ability component refuses is retried for
MaxRetryTime.

Settings replicate: sequence and objective events are runtime copies sent to clients as subobjects, which
a client builds from class defaults.

Native base of BP_MissionEvent_PlayMissionBriefing: its "Briefing Data" variable is moved into
Briefing.Variants on load.

/Script/IRRMissionSystem.IRRMissionEvent.name: IRRMissionEvent_FailMission
/Script/IRRMissionSystem.IRRMissionEvent.tooltip:
Loses the mission it is executed on. The mirror image of the completion path: every event array a mission,
a sequence and an objective already own can now end in a loss, so failing needs no objective of its own
(an objective whose completion means defeat, a sequence that must not be entered).

Server only by default - mission state is replicated, so a client failing its own copy would only fight
the next update.

Owner has to resolve to a mission: the manager-owned arrays (level manager, extraction) execute events
against themselves and have no mission to lose.

/Script/IRRMissionSystem.IRRMissionEvent.name: IRRMissionEvent_AddInboxEntry
/Script/IRRMissionSystem.IRRMissionEvent.tooltip:
Adds an inbox message for the owning mission. The message text is a dedicated "operation complete"
note (one of CompletionMessages, picked at random to stay varied) letting the operator know they
succeeded in the raid, can claim their reward and that the agent's faction is pleased. The reward
items are taken directly from the mission's built reward items.

CompletionMessages.$text: Operation complete, operator. Clean execution in the field - your handler is more than pleased with the result. Your compensation has been cleared; collect it whenever you're ready.
Nice work out there. Objective secured without leaving a mess, and that buys you real goodwill with us. Your reward is waiting - don't leave it sitting.
Mission successful. You got the job done and the higher-ups are impressed with how you handled it. Head over and claim what you've earned.
That's a wrap. The faction is happy with your execution on this one - exactly the kind of work we like to see. Your payment has been released for pickup.
Debrief received: flawless. You came through in the raid and the faction won't forget it. Your reward is ready to be collected at your convenience.
